Star ratings policy: Use On3/ESPN/247 when publicly listed for HS class. Most returning players and portal transfers do not have a consensus star published on the roster pages consulted → Not listed. Do not invent.
Class year policy: HS recruiting class year when known; otherwise eligibility class + “2026 TR” for portal arrivals this cycle.

Depth chart policy: WSU did not release an official Week-1 depth chart (Spokesman-Review, Aug 31, 2026). Only confirmed starter publicly named by the program: QB Caden Pinnick. Offense/defense two-deeps below follow the Spokesman-Review projected two-deep, with Daily Evergreen / Ourlads noted where they differ.
Injury notes (Moore via Spokesman): TE Trey Leckner out first half of season; TE Hudson Cedarland out extended period. Pedersen starts in their absence.
Daily Evergreen OL note: Same five projected starters (Tripp, Martin, Dunham, Bakken, Lester).
Ourlads (May) differs: Lester at LG, Martin at C, Dunham at RG, Caldwell at RT — treat as outdated vs. August camp projections.
Returning offensive starters (WSU release): Tony Freeman, Ashton Tripp, Jonny Lester, Kirby Vorhees.
Captains (WSU release): Kaden Beatty, Keith Brown, Tony Freeman, Jack Pedersen, Ashton Tripp, Linus Zunk.
